card.name: Names starting with I (Ian, Ipratropium)
card.fires_on: The first piece after a capital I that begins a name, such as Ian in a byline or the "pr" in Ipratropium, "cat" in Icatibant, or "od" in icodextrin. It also fires on the period in the initial "I. A."

modes.label: Drug names beginning I
modes.description: Early pieces of drug names starting with I, such as Ipratropium, Icatibant and icodextrin.

modes.label: Person names beginning Ian or I.
modes.description: The name Ian or an initial I. before a surname in author credits.

card.writes: It promotes odd name-continuation pieces, so it seems to help finish rare names that start with I.
card.plain: It lights up on the start of rare names that begin with the letter I, mostly drug names like ipratropium and a few people called Ian.
